membership_user_id.description: Membership to attach the document to.

form_id.description: Commitment document to attach, as returned by the signed forms report.

user_id.description: Arbox member ID. Use with customer_id or when customer_id exists for the member.

customer_id.description: customer unique identifier. Required unless user_id has customer_id.

personal_id.description: Customer ID number on the document.

email.description: Email to send the document to.

location_id.description: Location ID. Defaults to the API user's location.

quantity.description: Item quantity. Must be a positive whole number.

vat.description: Item VAT type. Defaults to the business default when omitted.

payments.description: Required for tax_invoice_receipt, receipt, and payment_receipt. Each object is one payment line.

amount.description: Payment amount. Required for all payment types.

due_date.description: Payment date (defaults to issuance date). Not used for deduction.

card_suffix.description: Last 4 digits of the card. Required when transaction_type is card.

card_brand.description: Card brand. Required when transaction_type is card.

num_of_payments.description: Number of card installments. Required when transaction_type is card.

payment_type.description: Card payment type. Required when transaction_type is card.

check_number.description: Check number. Required when transaction_type is check.

reference_number.description: Reference / asmachta number. Required for bank_transfer. Optional for bit and paybox.

voucher_type_id.description: Voucher type ID. Required when transaction_type is voucher.

voucher_number.description: Voucher number. Required when transaction_type is voucher.

bank_number.description: Bank code. Required when transaction_type is check or bank_transfer.

branch_number.description: Branch number. Required when transaction_type is check or bank_transfer.

account_number.description: Bank account number. Required when transaction_type is check or bank_transfer.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
